definitions.explanation: The central administrative office of a prefecture, and by extension the prefectural government as an organization.

examples.japanese: {県庁|けんちょう}に{勤|つと}めている。
examples.english: I work at the prefectural government office.

examples.japanese: その{手続|てつづ}きは{県庁|けんちょう}でできる。
examples.english: You can do that procedure at the prefectural office.

examples.japanese: {県庁|けんちょう}{所在地|しょざいち}は、その{県|けん}で{最|もっと}も{人口|じんこう}が{多|おお}い{都市|とし}とは{限|かぎ}らない。
examples.english: The city where the prefectural office is located is not necessarily the most populous city in the prefecture.

notes:
The administrative headquarters of a {県|けん} (prefecture). Can refer to the building itself or to the prefectural government as an organization.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {県庁|けんちょう}{所在地|しょざいち}: the prefectural capital (city where the office sits)
- {県庁|けんちょう}に{勤|つと}める: to work at the prefectural office
- {県庁|けんちょう}{前|まえ}: in front of the prefectural office (a common place name)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {市役所|しやくしょ}: city hall — the equivalent office at the municipal level
- {都庁|とちょう}: Tokyo Metropolitan Government office — the equivalent for {東京都|とうきょうと}
